cohort: The study included 200 term neonates delivered via elective caesarean section over the course of one year.
finding: Elective caesarean sections performed after 39 weeks of gestation are associated with lower rates of respiratory morbidity in term infants compared to those performed between 37 and 39 weeks.
followup_time: Acute post-birth (e.g., 4 hours for oxygen support, length of hospital stay)
gest_age: Term neonates (37 weeks to 41 weeks 6 days)
